sources.function: step / ease / rand / signal / glow / mat

studio: Root Group with HemisphereLight, three DirectionalLights, sky sphere radius 650 (32x16), 380 deterministic dust points over range 140.
wide=true changes key shadow camera left/right from ±20 to ±48; top32 bottom-20 near0.5 far130.
ocean: PlaneGeometry(size,size,180,180), rotateX(-PI/2), at [0,y,z]. Wave displacement in vertex shader: sin(v.z*.25+t*.65)*.13 + sin(v.x*.43+v.z*.13-t*.5)*.08.
Shader normal sums eight directional waves: k=i+1; d=[cos(k*1.73),sin(k*1.73)]; a=dot(p.xz,d)*(.5+k*.62)+t*(.6+k*.13); amp=.05/k^.23; slopes+=d*cos(a)*amp.
helpers: mat(color,m=.55,r=.4,e=0) sets emissive=color, emissiveIntensity=e. cyl uses CylinderGeometry(top,r,h,n=40) along local Y. tube uses CatmullRomCurve3 unless provided a Curve; TubeGeometry(n,r,8,false).

signal creates emissive tube radius r plus additive glow sprite and PointLight(color,45,20,1.7); at(q) uses getPointAt(clamp(q)), i.e. arc length. glow uses a shared 128² radial CanvasTexture and AdditiveBlending/depthWrite=false/toneMapped=false.

materials_light.ocean: base(.012,.026,.053) + (.026,.048,.095)*fresnel^4 + glint*half-vector shine^80*2.8; mist=1-exp(-distance*.0018), blend to(.018,.03,.075). Defaults source[-15,25,-100],glint#a8b9e8.
materials_light.practical: Group at position containing PointLight(color,intensity,distance,2) then glow(sprite,size,color); child order is used by animation.
materials_light.physical: RoomEnvironment PMREM(.04), default environmentIntensity .25 overridden by each builder; ACESFilmicToneMapping exposure .85; ThreeCanvas720x1280,dpr1.5; Camera resets up, offset, near.01 far1500 every frame.

camera.global: Builder eye/look are world positions, vertical fov in degrees; returned offset uses camera.setViewOffset(720,1280,x,y,720,1280).

animation.deterministic_helpers: step(t,a,b)=clamp((t-a)/(b-a)); ease(q)=q²(3-2q); mix(a,b,q)=a+(b-a)q; rand(i)=fract(sin(i*127.1+31.7)*43758.5453). Ocean.update writes clock and eye every call.

clocks.input: All scenes receive local t=frame/30-shotStart; ocean shader receives that local clock.

adjustable_parameters: Change size, color and source position together with camera composition. Counts and topology are native constants, not asserted quality limits. Native shadow-map/view-offset conventions must be retained for exact replay.
failure_cases: Do not substitute plain meshes for practical children without updating child-index animation.
Use true getPointAt for signal motion; replacing with getPoint changes speed.
Sky radius650 and per-scene fog matter; environment/tonemapping are outside builder root.
recipes.reuse_principle: Separate physical emitter, its visible glow and the surface that receives it; deterministic local time drives both world and shader.

adjustable_parameters: Bank limit supports stable low canyon without removing ripple silhouette; keep central cable lane clear.

failure_cases: Applying another dark base tint beneath weather multiplies away lit rock detail (source comment).
Changing clock without recalibrating landmark rays shifts measured composition.
marineRun intentionally freezes undersea dust/hot/shadow at t0; advancing set.update(t) changes native output.
recipes.reuse_principle: Build stable depth cues from true world geometry and calibrated landmarks; reserve sprites for light and fine particulate.

geometryHierarchy.photoSampling: photoValues draws [0, 0, photo.width, photo.height * 0.95] into a 192 × 180 canvas. Each value k is round(0.2126 * R + 0.7152 * G + 0.0722 * B). The detailed field contains 34,560 cells. Decimal and binary atlases are 4096 × 4096 with 16 × 16 cells of 256 pixels each. Decimal labels are 0–255. Binary labels use (k * 257).toString(2).padStart(16, 0), displayed as four rows of four bits.
geometryHierarchy.nearField: For instance i, x = i % 192 - 95.5; z = (floor(i / 192) - 117) * 1.28. terrain = (sin(x * 0.22 + z * 0.065) + cos(z * 0.18 - x * 0.07) + 2) / 4. Height y = 0.10 + terrain * 0.48 + (k / 255) * 0.22 + rand(i + 240) * 0.32. Body geometry is [0.97, 1, 1.23], positioned at [x, (y + 0.01) / 2, z], scaled [1, y + 0.25, 1]. Rim geometry is [0.98, 0.075, 1.24] at y + 0.085. Faces are 0.91 × 1.17 at y + 0.13, rotated -π/2 around X. Atlas offset is [(k % 16) / 16, 1 - (floor(k / 16) + 1) / 16].
geometryHierarchy.farField: The coarse field contains 128 × 140 = 17,920 cells. For row r, size = 1.5 + r * 0.022; z = -151 - r * 2.8; x = (column - 63.5) * size; y = 0.20 + rand(i + 355) * 0.65. The value is values[(i * 17) % values.length]. Body scale is [size, y + 0.25, 2.18]; face scale is [size, 2.18, 1]. A 900 × 0.1 × 950 far ground sits at [0, -0.22, -380]; the near floor is 160 × 0.2 × 220 at [0, -0.22, -30].
geometryHierarchy.photoTiles: The photograph contains 16,384 faces of 0.248 × 0.248 and matching bodies of 0.248 × 0.248 × 0.12. Tile x = (column - 63.5) * 0.25; tile y = (63.5 - row) * 0.25. UV offset is [column / 128, 0.05 + (1 - (row + 1) / 128) * 0.95]; the face shader divides base UV by [128, 134.736842]. The intact plane is 32 × 32 at z = 0.16 and crops its vertical UV to 0.05–1.0.
geometryHierarchy.lock: The kit padlock has hoop scale Y = 0.62. Its extra blue face is 0.97 × 0.76 × 0.05. The key rim radius is 0.245, back disk radius 0.222, keyhole disk radius 0.066, and stem 0.068 × 0.14. Four corner bolts have radius 0.027. The gripper and lens are separate recipes.
geometryHierarchy.packetCloud: There are 1,500 rounded packet bodies of 1.8 × 0.83 × 0.15 with corner radius 0.055. Headers are 1.8 × 0.24 × 0.14, translated [0, 0.46, -0.005]. Subdivision planes are 1.8 × 0.83 at z = 0.084 and show a 6 × 3 grid from a 720 × 332 canvas. Seam faces duplicate those planes at z + 0.004. Packet origins form 30 columns and 50 rows: [(column - 14.5) * 7, 0.95, 50 - row * 5.2], then multiply by 0.5 and rotate Y by -0.13.
geometryHierarchy.heroCard: The header is 5.5 × 3 with corner radius 0.33 in a group initially at [0, 2.30, -0.04]. Its address texture is 1100 × 600. The front is 5.5 × 3.45 with corner radius 0.31, extrusion depth 0.16 and bevel 0.025. It sits in a group at [0, 0.475, 0]. Address rows read From / Shanghai · Mom's phone and To / Los Angeles · Your phone. The #0847 number uses an 1100 × 460 texture on a 4.3 × 1.8 plane at z = 0.225.

materialsLight.light: Multiply studio light intensities by 0.30, except the #294be5 rim, which uses 0.075. Add a #ffe6a2 point light with intensity 95, distance 100, decay 2 at [-3, 7, -19]. Add a #ffe8ad directional graze light with intensity 1.4 at [-12, 5, -24], aimed at [0, 0, -3]. Environment intensity is 0.30. Fog is #080e22 with density 0.004. The additional radius-400 sky computes h = exp(-((normalizedY - 0.02) * 7)^2) and mixes RGB [0.006, 0.010, 0.027] toward [0.035, 0.055, 0.135].
materialsLight.field: Bodies use #141a1e, metalness 0.58, roughness 0.43; rims use #302c1d, metalness 0.72, roughness 0.25. Number faces use map and emissiveMap, emissive #fff3c4 at intensity 1.1, color #c7bc94, roughness 0.84, metalness 0.10. A shader patch multiplies emitted light by instance color. Face brightness = (0.05 + sqrt(k / 255) * 0.15 + exp(-((x + 5)^2 / 100 + (z + 4)^2 / 210)) * 0.65 + rand(i + 583) * 0.11) * (0.28 + 0.72 * exp(-(z + 7)^2 / 3200)).
materialsLight.cloud: Packet body color changes from #f3a503 to #ffc20a while roughness changes 0.61→0.44 over native 37.4–38.0. The key point light is #ffdc55 at [-7 + sin((native - 37.4) * 0.7) * 1.4, 13, 8], rising to intensity 780, distance 55, decay 2. The rim is #ffc837 at [9, 5, 2], rising to intensity 580, distance 48, decay 2. Both body and header shaders multiply complete outgoingLight by a cloudFocus value that changes 1→0.21 over 39.45–40.2.
materialsLight.depth: For 37.4 ≤ native < 41.8, PacketDepth is active with aperture 0.00016 * blend(native, 37.4, 38.0), focus distance 32→18 over 39.45–40.2, and maxblur 0.012. Sky meshes render on layer 2 separately. The hero renders sharply on layer 1 after the blurred cloud and a depth clear.

camera.actualFieldCamera: Before 23.3, d = blend(native, 21.76, 22.30) * (1 - blend(native, 22.30, 23.30)). Interpolate baseline eye toward [-1.2, 2.4, 5.4] by 0.48*d, and roll toward 0.22 by d. After 23.3, wide = blend(native, 25, 27.8) * (1 - blend(native, 36.8, 37.4)); inspect = blend(native, 30.2, 31.6); pull = blend(native, 35, 36.8). Alternate eye = [1.5*inspect*(1-pull), mix(13+4*inspect, 21, pull), mix(35-6*inspect, 40, pull)]; look = [0, 2.5*inspect*(1-pull), -2-10*pull]; roll = mix(mix(-0.16, 0, blend(native, 27, 28.5)), 0.15, inspect)*(1-pull). Interpolate baseline eye/look/roll toward these alternate values by wide.
camera.foregroundCompensation: The optical camera uses the baseline pose. Foreground.matrix = fieldCamera.matrixWorld * opticalCamera.matrixWorldInverse, with matrixAutoUpdate = false. Gripper and lens placement first uses baseline-camera pixel unprojection at depths 27 and 23, respectively. This matrix preserves their intended screen placement under the revised actual field camera.

animation.photoToField: dive = blend(native, 21.76, 22.3); showData = blend(native, 22.72, 23.32). The intact plane is visible before 21.83; tile faces and bodies are visible from 21.83. The photograph group is visible before 23.34, with rotation X = -π/2 * dive and position Y = 0.4*dive. Tile wave = sin(x*0.14 + y*0.10 + native*1.5)*dive*0.12 + rand(i+950)*dive*0.055. Tile scale = (1-showData)*(1-dive*0.06). Faces sit at wave + 0.16; photo-face brightness changes 1→0.62 with dive.
animation.field: The world is visible for 22.65 < native < 37.20. Opacity = blend(native, 22.65, 23.05) * (1 - blend(native, 36.83, 37.20)). animation.lockAndInspection: Lock rise is 27.1–28.4, close is 29.15–29.6, retreat is 29.6–31.6, and exit is 34.08–35.1. Let r = retreat blend, u = rise blend, e = exit blend. Lock scale = mix(2.9, 1.65, r)*(1-e), with negative X scale. Position = [mix(0.2, -5.5, r), mix(-3, mix(4.4, 7, r), u), mix(7, -4, r)]; rotation = [-0.25, -0.16, 0]. animation.packetFormation: For each packet row, cue = 36.48 + row*0.008; formed = blend(native, cue, cue+0.075); lift = blend(native, cue+0.16, cue+0.55); travel = blend(native, cue+0.23, 37.50+rand(i+80)*0.17). Source cells inside |x| < 105 and -207 < z < 52 shrink by retain = 1-blend(native, formationCue(z), formationCue(z)+0.075), where formationCue(z) = 36.48 + max(0, (50-z)/5.2)*0.008. Packet orientation slerps from Euler [-π/2, -0.13, 0] in YXZ order toward airTurn by lift. Temporary rise = sin(lift*π/2)*2.8*(1-travel). Subdivision alpha = 1-blend(native, cue+0.05, cue+0.18); seam alpha = 0.92*exp(-((native-cue-0.042)/0.022)^2).
animation.cloudTargets: Near instances i < 96 use x = (rand(i+601)-0.5)*24, y = (rand(i+410)-0.5)*44+4, z = 14-rand(i+908)*24, size = 1.10+rand(i+207)*0.45. Middle instances 96–595 use X/Y spans 60/95, z = -12-rand(i+908)*43, size = 1+rand(i+207)*0.25. Far instances 596–1499 use spans 270/460, z = -55-rand(i+908)*175, size = 0.80+rand(i+207)*0.4. For near cards, depth = 28-z, hh = depth*tan(25°), hw = hh*720/1280, nx = (rand(i+601)-0.5)*2.8, ny = (rand(i+410)-0.5)*2.6. Position interpolates from origin to target by travel; Z additionally subtracts (native-38)*1.1*travel.
animation.orientationColor: tumble = 1-blend(native, 37.02, 37.85); settled = blend(native, 37.4, 38.0). Air Euler components use rand offsets 23/70/92 minus 0.5, multiplied by [0.10, 0.18, 0.08] + settled*[0.30, 0.28, 0.27] + tumble*[4.4, 4, 4]. Instance X/Y scale = [mix(1.80, size, travel), mix(2.44, size, travel)] * formed * nearScale; Z scale stays 1. animation.heroReveal: The hero is visible from 39.8. Position = [0, 5.30+0.11*blend(native, 40.4, 41.7), 12]. Scale = mix(0.22, 0.91, blend(native, 39.8, 40.35))*(1+0.014*blend(native, 40.3, 41.7)); roll = 0.009*sin((native-40.3)*1.7)*focus. geometryHierarchy.optics: Build a plane from the sample face world position and its transformed local +Z normal. Cast rays from the actual camera eye through every world-space lens vertex into that plane, then convert hits into sample-face local coordinates. Let center be the mapped optical-center point. UV = 0.5 + (center + (hit-center)/1.85) / [5.23,5.25]. This magnifies the shared sample texture by 1.85. UV samples outside 0–1 are replaced by RGB [0.012,0.018,0.021].

materialsLight.materials: Steel #b9c9d6 uses metalness 0.96, roughness 0.13; dark #09131f uses 0.86/0.24; the fine gold ring #d1bc7b uses 0.83/0.20. recipes.camera: The lens follows the baseline camera quaternion and uses pixel unprojection at depth 23. Foreground compensation maps it to the actual field camera. Its optics are recomputed using the actual camera eye after both world matrices update.

camera.pixelPlacement: place unprojects [x/720*2-1,1-y/1280*2,0.5], normalizes the ray from the camera eye, and computes distance = (z-eye.z)/ray.z. Position = eye + distance*ray. Scale = width/720*(14-z)*2*tan(47*π/360)*(720/1280)/2. The formula assumes a two-unit card width.

animation.focus: t = 41.8+local; focus = blend(t,42.03,42.40); pulse = blend(t,42.4,42.94). Before 44.7, the room-mode hero moves from pixel [102,352] to [374,275], width 100→230, roll 0.065→0. Room-card roll is its stored tilt + sin(local*0.23+i)*0.009.
animation.cloudSwitch: At t ≥ 44.7, hide the room stage and room cards, show the cloud, and activate depth focus. The hero instantly moves to [360,548], width 176, roll 0. For each deep card, z = -10-rand(i+930)*60; x = (rand(i+580)-0.5)*850+360; baseY = (rand(i+681)-0.5)*1600+640; y = baseY+(t-44.7)*8. Projected width = mix(63,14,(-z-10)/60). Yaw = (rand(i)-0.5)*0.22; roll = (rand(i+31)-0.5)*0.24. Brightness = (0.16+rand(i+887)*0.48)*mix(1,0.20,(-z-10)/60)*mix(1,0.14,step(baseY,850,1160)).

camera.arrival: For local ≤ 2.6: eye [0,17,23], look [0,0,-1], FOV 48. For local > 2.6: q=step(local,2.6,5); eye=[mix(0,-4,q),mix(22,4.5,q),mix(22,10,q)], look=[0,0,1]. This produces a code discontinuity immediately after 2.6, jumping to eye [0,22,22] and look Z=1 before the interpolation.

animation.permutation: Shuffled slot = slots[(i*997+271)%1500]. For arrival, q=0. For sort, q=ease(step(local,0.8+rand(i)*0.7,2.35+rand(i)*0.35)). For retransmit, q=1. Position interpolates shuffled→target by q, with added Y=sin(q*π)*(0.4+rand(i)*1.5).
animation.arrival: arrive=ease(step(local,rand(i)*0.5,1.2+rand(i)*1.4)); added Y=(1-arrive)*(5+rand(i+5)*15). Missing identities stay hidden; the other 1,497 packets land in shuffled slots by local 2.6. Tags stay hidden. Counter=round(1497*step(local,0.3,1.8)). Before 2.6, the metric is centered at 27% with font size 87; afterward it is left-aligned at x=42, top 14%, size 52.
animation.sort: The 1,497 packets arch from shuffled slots to ordered slots. Starts range 0.8–1.5; endpoints range 2.35–2.7. Tags are visible only when local > 4 and use X rotation -0.8. Missing holes persist. The metric stays 1,497 / 1,500.
animation.retransmit: For missing-array index m=0,1,2, the packet is visible only if local > (m+1)*0.9. Let r=ease(step(local,(m+1)*0.9,(m+1)*0.9+0.6)); position=target+[0,9*(1-r),0]. The matching red tag is visible while local < (m+1)*0.9. Counter=1497+min(3,floor(local/0.9)). Globe-route progress=step(local,0,2.8). The final fall window is local 2.7–3.3 but the shot cuts at local 3.067.

recipes.clocks: Each board shot starts its own local clock: arrival 116.833–121.9, sort 121.9–127.9, retransmit 127.9–130.967. All positions are recomputed from the permutation and target slots every frame.

recipes.animation: Camera glides slightly down/forward/left for6.86s then stays. Only geometry animation is none: practical intensity breathes32+12*sin(local*.7), with first maximum at local pi/1.4, midpoint baseline at pi/.7, minimum at3pi/1.4. Source scene remains fully built throughout.
recipes.clocks: nativeFrame = sample offset + composition frame; nativeTime = nativeFrame/30; localTime = nativeTime - exact source SHOTS origin. step(t,a,b)=clamp((t-a)/(b-a),0,1); ease(p)=p*p*(3-2*p); mix(a,b,p)=a+(b-a)*p. Do not round shot origins to frame boundaries.

all model bases/routes must use h
failure_cases: extensions.finalNetwork and production-scenes.networkHorizon are inactive alternatives with different movement.
Do not insert a traveling packet: active infrastructureWorld never constructs one.
Never substitute earth_night texture: source uses generated planar city-light texture.
Camera target fixed while eye moves; rotating world to fake travel changes parallax.
recipes.reuse_principle: End on a curved miniature collection of heterogeneous hardware, with one camera glide and a gentle light variation; let the narration connect the static components.

geometry_hierarchy.grain: 512x512 Canvas random(grain+i), gray128+(random-.5)*255, full alpha; CSS overlay blend; per-frame backgroundPosition floor(random(gx+fr)*512),floor(random(gy+fr)*512).
geometry_hierarchy.captions: source caption find first with start<=nativeTime<end; top907,left/right30,width660; FilmBody35 weight700,lineHeight1.08,center white;textShadow0 2px 3px black plus ±1px horizontal2px; WebkitTextStroke1px #0008; paintOrder stroke fill. regex-highlighted numeric phrases get#ffc52c.

materials_light.bloom: SVG film-bloom threshold approximation: channel2.6*c-1.62; blur9 and42; arithmetic mix .55*bloom and.75*bloom, then screen blend over source; active bloom=.7, coefficients .385/.525.
materials_light.grain: Default.075; only native37.4<=t<41.8 special mix(.075,.018,ease(step(t,37.4,38))) then returns .075. Assigned globe/network windows always .075.

recipes.camera: Optical handoff is CSS scale/blur on picture wrapper, separate from camera. incoming=enterSet?1-ease(step(local,0,.23)):0; outgoing=exitSet?ease(step(local,duration-.2,duration)):0; p=max(incoming,outgoing); scale=1+p*(large?1.8:.32),blur=p*(large?20:9)px iff p>.001; transformOrigin50%47%; large only undersea/earth-pacific.

animation.assigned_handoffs: earth-pacific both; network-intro exit; both network entries; router none; reroute exit; earth-web entry; satellite none; Atlantic both; return entry; web-ending exit; final entry.
animation.timer: Visible12.167<=t<139.167; assigned intro/network/web/satellite all use small timer top169,right44,size56,unit17,cyan#86dcff,textShadow0 0 14px #56bfff88. Value from latest observedTimer record timestamp<=t for20.367<=t<139.167; always padStart(3,0). No timer in first Pacific or any ending shots after142.
animation.audio: Single mixed reference-audio.wav with startFrom=sample.offset or0 frames; no isolated stems recovered. No invented scene-specific sound-effect attribution.

recipes.clocks: nativeFrame = sample offset + composition frame; nativeTime = nativeFrame/30; localTime = nativeTime - exact source SHOTS origin. step(t,a,b)=clamp((t-a)/(b-a),0,1); ease(p)=p*p*(3-2*p); mix(a,b,p)=a+(b-a)*p. Do not round shot origins to frame boundaries. Finish noise and caption/timer gates follow native frame/time; optical handoff follows exact local+duration.
dependencies: timer.json events override coarse TIMER interpolation
failure_cases: Scaling captions with scene changes source behavior.
Resetting grain frame on a shot changes finish.
Rendering optical handoff as crossfade is incorrect: only current picture is magnified/blurred.
The film-bloom id and SVG filter must exist in same document.
No final fade-out exists in active final-network; picture persists to cut, and last caption ends161.7.
recipes.reuse_principle: Keep story-critical typography crisp above the image finish; use a short optical scale handoff to bridge scale changes while maintaining exact frame-driven time.
